name: Reverse UI · Radial Menu

title.zh: Reverse UI · 适合寻找现成动画 UI 组件

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Reverse UI 提供 68 个可集成的动画 UI 组件，首页按月份列出 Proximity Navigation、Radial Menu、Luminous Logo、Particle Field 等条目，每条可进入独立组件页查看。站点强调样式与动画已处理，并提供 Browse components 与 Get lifetime access 入口。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Reverse UI (https://reverseui.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
